title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 46
text:
Financial Flow Example
Level of Payment Which Condition 
Applies? Limit Used
How the Loss Is 
Determined (Same 
Logic as Screenshot)
1. Loss paid by 
Sub-condition LA County Sublimit $10M
Paid amount = Loss (for 
LA County) or $10M 
(whichever is smaller). 
This is the first cap 
applied.
2. Loss paid by Primary 
Sublimit California Sublimit $50M
Paid amount = Loss 
(California) + (amount 
paid under LA 
sub-condition), but 
capped at $50M, or 
whichever is smaller.
3. Loss paid by Policy 
Limit Full EQ Policy $250M × 50% = $125M 
participation
Paid amount = Loss (all 
other CA + non-CA) + 
(amount paid under 
Primary Sublimit), but 
limited by policy’s share.
4. Loss not covered Outside all conditions —
Any loss beyond the 
applied limits is not 
covered and is passed 
back to the insured.
